_rationale: Trad balance $30k < requested $100k conversion → conversion executes the full $30k Trad balance (limited by tradAvailForConv). Tax cannot be paid from Taxable (no Taxable) or RMD-excess (age 60, no RMD), so the federal tax on ~$30k single 60 (std ded ~$15.75k → ~$14k taxable → 10% = ~$1,400) is withheld from the conversion itself (IRS Form 1099-R Box 4). withdrawalFromTraditional ≈ $30k (the full balance), rothConversionGross = $30k (conversion principal), rothConversionTaxWithheld ≈ $1,400, Roth deposit (computed: gross − withheld) ≈ $28,600. rothConversionRequested records the user's $100k intent → conversionShortfallDollars ≈ $70k.
